items.title: Why a coach's site isn't a Linktree
items.summary: Link-in-bio tools list links. A Station 9 site runs the business: coaching, programmes, race tools, community and the money desk.
items.take: The difference isn't the features. It's that everything a creator's audience needs lives in one place, under their brand.

items.title: The race tools nobody else ships
items.summary: Race predictor, split analyser, station prep, race-mate boards — tools built for hybrid athletes, not generic widgets.
items.take: A calculator that knows what wall balls do to your run splits isn't a gimmick. It's the reason athletes keep coming back.

items.title: Where the athletes' data lives
items.summary: Every athlete on a Station 9 site gets one account across the network — their cards, RSVPs and results follow them, not the site.
items.take: Coaches keep their athletes. The network just makes every community bigger — that's the deal, written into the contract.
